'''Gaffer Gamgee We DO Need Their Scum v 2.5''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Gaffer Gamgee]]
* '''Published:''' 18 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile Gamgee DS 2003 WeDONeed 4515.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Use bounty hunters to mount a ferocious assault against the Light Side. If they choose not to fight use direct damage to put a crimp in their style!

== Strategy ==

Pull Mighty Jabba using the Audience Chamber on first turn. Grab Boelo and Ephont Mon on subsequent turns using Power of the Hutt. Those three allow you to get two destinies and cancel one of your opponents. They are a good protection against beat-down.

Get hunters out as quick as possible for some direct battling/capturing.

Changes:

I put the Sail Barge and its site back in to give me a little more Force activation.

I added the Punishing One (V) for more space power and I added Dengar's Riot Gun to ease the capturing process.

I added Search and Destroy (Shewski) to put some more direct damage on a hiding opponent.

I'm starting Kryat Dragon Bones (V) and hoping to draw Desilijic Tattoo (V) as early as possible.

Cards I dropped: End this Destructive Conflict, a Bounty, a None Shall Pass, Release Your Anger, and something else that i forgot ;)

Let me know if you think this is good enough to finally earn a 4! ;)
